These rules explain eligibility, immediate effects, controlled recovery, irreversible deletion, and data-retention boundaries. Signing out, withdrawing privacy consent, and deactivating an account are different actions.

These rules apply when you request deactivation of the current business account from the XingDun IM Android client. When an enterprise administrator disables a member account because of departure, misconduct, or security concerns, enterprise rules and platform governance procedures apply instead.

Go to My - Settings - Account & Security - Deactivate Account. To prevent impersonation, you must verify the current password, read the effects, acknowledge them, and complete a second destructive-action confirmation. Device accounts must first bind a verifiable username and password.

• Confirm the current account, enterprise, and affected data, and save information you are legally entitled to retain when needed.
• Resolve unfinished red-packet, appeal, report, enterprise approval, or dispute matters.
• Organization owners and accounts with critical administrative duties must transfer authority under enterprise rules.
• Data may be subject to legal retention when an account is involved in a judicial or administrative investigation or a security incident.

• The active business account is removed from the user table, and all devices, JWTs, UserSig issuance eligibility, and push identifiers are invalidated immediately.
• The client signs out of Tencent IM, stops notifications and incoming-call registration, and clears local credentials, account data, and session state.
• You can no longer sign in, send or receive messages, make calls, access the enterprise directory, or use Workspace.
• Necessary display names may be replaced with “Deactivated User,” but messages already received by others are not removed.

To prevent mistakes and address enterprise relationships, security incidents, and disputes, deactivated account data and device snapshots enter a restricted server recovery area. You cannot restore the account yourself; recovery requires an enterprise administrator to verify your identity and organization relationship.\n\nYou may ask Help & Feedback or an enterprise administrator for irreversible deletion during the recovery stage. After approval, administrators permanently remove the business identity and recovery snapshot.

Tencent Cloud commercial SDKAppIDs may not currently support physical deletion of imported Tencent UserIDs. XingDun IM signs the user out, stops issuing UserSigs, and removes the business-identity association. After permanent deletion, Tencent may retain only a technical identifier that cannot independently identify your business data or sign in to XingDun IM.

• Messages and files already received, forwarded, favorited, or lawfully retained by other users.
• Approvals, audits, organization changes, and business records lawfully managed by the enterprise.
• Red-packet orders, claims, refunds, and other transaction records retained by law or for dispute handling.
• Reports, content safety, sign-in, security incident, and operational audit records retained for legally required or reasonable periods.

Data no longer needed and not subject to legal retention is deleted or anonymized after the recovery process. Residual backup data remains isolated for the backup replacement cycle, is not used for ordinary business except system-security restoration, and is removed when that cycle ends.\n\nData that must remain is used only for legal obligations, security audits, or dispute handling, not for marketing or unrelated purposes.
9. Difference from signing out and withdrawing consent

Signing out does not delete the account. Withdrawing privacy consent stops client services but does not request account deactivation. Deactivation immediately disables the business account and starts recovery and deletion. If you only want to stop using the app temporarily, sign out instead.

For questions about deactivation results, retention scope, recovery, or irreversible deletion, submit a request through My - Help & Feedback. We may verify the account, enterprise relationship, and requester identity and respond within the period required by law.

Check your account, password or verification code and your network. Contact the enterprise administrator if the account is disabled. Support will never ask for your password or verification code.
Why was my account signed out?

Another device login, an administrator security action, or expired credentials may sign this device out. Sign in again after confirming account security. Change your password immediately if the activity was not yours.
How do I change my phone number or email?
Open My - Settings - Account & Security and verify the new phone number or email address. Contact details cannot be changed directly from your profile.
Why don’t I receive message alerts?
Open Settings - Notifications and check system notification access, sound and vibration. Also make sure the conversation is not muted.
Why did a photo, audio, video or file fail to send?
Check the network, camera, photo and microphone permissions and the file size. Failed messages remain in the chat and can be tapped to resend.
Does clearing cache delete chat history?
No. Storage management removes only local media cache. Media may be downloaded again; Tencent IM messages and server favorites are preserved.
Why can’t I find a colleague?
Search by XingDun account, phone number or Tencent UserID and confirm both users belong to the same enterprise and both accounts are active.
Why can’t I edit group information?
Group details, announcements, administrators and members are managed by the owner or administrators. Members can view group information or request to join according to group settings.
